idiom.note: raw pinned threads + one bounded SPSC ring per (worker, worker) pair; every actor of the reference network an integer with its state in a vector slot; qb's step placement; not an actor framework and not ranked as one

caveats: THIS IS NOT A FRAMEWORK. Actors are integers, a message is one ring push and one ring pop, and there is no scheduler: the floor for moving 541 869 small messages (at the defaults) through a fixed network
each step of the network lives whole on one worker and the steps are cut into contiguous halves of equal message weight at cores=2 -- the same placement qb gets -- so a value crosses a worker once
cores=1 is one thread pushing every message into its own ring and popping it back -- the floor for single-threaded dispatch, still a real queue
wait=1 busy-polls the rings; wait=0 parks an idle worker on a condition variable
